text.p: Twenty three Belgian Internet gateway companies said on Tuesday they had founded the Internet Service Provider Association (ISPA) to promote their interests in Belgium.

"The founding of the ISPA marks an important stage in the process of representation of the Internet industry... ISPA hopes to cooperate with other Internet actors with the aim of opening up the sector," ISPA said in a statement.
The 23 Internet service providers said they represented around 85 percent of the country's total internet market.

ISPA aims to provide media coverage of the Internet and its users, promote a code of good conduct for Internet service providers and inform members of the technical and social problems and development which affect the Internet industry.

The Internet has come under close scrutiny in Belgium recently because of the availability of pornographic paedophile material. Four children were found dead this summer after being kidnapped and abused by a child sex gang.
